product.summary: Browser-based MyCrypto Ethereum account-management interface, currently reachable at app.mycrypto.com.
product.notes: The official MyCrypto web application remains publicly available at app.mycrypto.com with current account-access options and a Contact Support path. MyCrypto's official Knowledge Base explicitly distinguishes the desktop application as an older version that is not actively maintained while directing users to the latest version of MyCrypto on mycrypto.com. WLR therefore records the web product as supported. This support classification does not assert active feature development or a current source-code release cadence; the public MyCrypto source repository's mainline implementation history has been quiet since 2022.

events.title: MyCrypto brand launched
events.description: MyCrypto launched as a new Ethereum wallet-interface brand following the split between Taylor Monahan and the MyEtherWallet project.
events.notes: The February 10 launch FAQ describes the brand launch as having occurred within the preceding day; WLR retains month-level precision rather than inventing an exact launch timestamp.

events.title: Consensys acquired MyCrypto
events.description: Consensys announced the acquisition of MyCrypto to combine its work with MetaMask while MyCrypto stated that its existing products would continue operating in the short term.
events.notes: The acquisition announcement described gradual product convergence rather than an immediate MyCrypto shutdown.
